pairs.why: The two clocks are almost identical; A's slightly deeper, more shaded orange rim is a little closer to the real clock's chunky bezel.
This is the q032 pair swapped: B is q032's A, with a slightly deeper rim, but the difference is marginal.
A's plain blue headphones with no cable match the real card, and its controller reads as the same chunky, smooth toy-like plastic; B adds a yellow ring and a cable that the real card lacks.
This is the q034 pair swapped: B has the simple cableless blue headphones and the cleaner controller finish of the real card.
B's chest has smoother, less busy wood and gold, nearer the real chest's soft finish; A has more plank grain and studs, which pushes it toward the too-textured side.
This is the q036 pair swapped: A is the smoother, less studded chest, closer to the real card's soft gold-and-wood finish.
A is smoother and simpler, with plainer portholes and less rigging and ladder detail, closer to the real ship's soft finish; B is more texture-heavy and ornate.
This is the q038 pair swapped: B is the smoother, less detailed ship that better matches the real card's clean surfaces.
